watches.name: Series No. 1 - "Layne" - Black Sunburst Dial w/ Red Seconds Hands
watches.description: PRE-ORDER PRODUCT Estimated shipping: February 2027 SERIES NO. 1 - LAYNE Black dial. Red hands. A different take on the Layne. The Layne is the first watch I've created under M. Ryan Watch Designs. I wanted the design to have a strong presence on the wrist without relying on oversized dimensions or unnecessary decoration. The black sunburst dial gives this version its foundation. The red hands bring the contrast, giving the watch a completely different character while keeping the dial clean and highly legible. MADE TO BE WORN At 41mm with a 48mm lug-to-lug, the Layne has a substantial wrist presence while maintaining balanced proportions. The front crystal and exhibition caseback both use sapphire crystal, and Swiss Super-LumiNova is used generously on the hands and markers. BUILT WITH CONFIDENCE • Designed & Assembled in the USA • Quality control tested • Water resistance pressure tested • 2-year international limited warranty FIRST PRODUCTION RUN - 300 WATCHES The first Layne production run is 300 watches across five versions. Only 50 Black Dial with Red Hands watches will be produced in this first run. Production is already underway, with estimated shipping beginning February 2027. Pre-orders ship in the order they are received. M. RYAN WATCH DESIGNS GIVES BACK **$10 from every Layne Series No. 1 watch sold will be donated by M. Ryan Watch Designs to SLC6A1 Connect** SLC6A1 Connect is a parent-led organization supporting families affected by SLC6A1-related disorders, funding research, advancing treatments, and working toward a cure. [Learn More About SLC6A1 Connect →](https://slc6a1connect.org)

watches.name: Series No. 1 - "Layne" - C3 Full-Lume Dial & PVD Case
watches.description: PRE-ORDER PRODUCT Estimated shipping: February 2027 SERIES NO. 1 - LAYNE Full-lume dial. C3 Grade X1 Super-LumiNova. Built to light up. The Layne is the first watch I've created under M. Ryan Watch Designs. I wanted the design to have a strong presence on the wrist without relying on oversized dimensions or unnecessary decoration. The Full-Lume dial version takes the Layne in a completely different direction. The entire dial is finished with C3 Grade X1 Super-LumiNova, creating an exceptionally bright luminous surface in low light. Black printed hour numerals provide the contrast, giving the dial its distinctive look while keeping the layout clean and highly legible. MADE TO BE WORN At 41mm with a 48mm lug-to-lug, the Layne has a substantial wrist presence while maintaining balanced proportions. The front crystal and exhibition caseback both use sapphire crystal with a regulated Miyota 9132 inside the case as the beating heart of the watch. BUILT WITH CONFIDENCE • Designed & Assembled in the USA • Quality control tested • Water resistance pressure tested • 2-year international limited warranty FIRST PRODUCTION RUN - 300 WATCHES The first Layne production run is 300 watches across five versions. watches.name: Series No. 1 - "Layne" - Green Fume Dial & Gunmetal PVD Case
watches.description: PRE-ORDER PRODUCT Estimated shipping: February 2027 SERIES NO. 1 - LAYNE Green fume dial. Gun metal PVD case. A Layne that stands apart. The Layne is the first watch I've created under M. Ryan Watch Designs. I wanted the design to have a strong presence on the wrist without relying on oversized dimensions or unnecessary decoration. The green fume dial brings depth and color to the design, with the green center gradually darkening toward the edges. Paired with the dark gunmetal PVD case, this version has a more modern, darker character than the stainless steel models. And there's a detail you won't see on the other versions: the M. Ryan Watch Designs logo on the dial is lumed. At night, the logo lights up alongside the hour numerals, markers, and hands.
